verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ebram vwọ ikpe ọvo nuro vwẹ ujori re Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ Ebram, ọ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba, yan nene uvwe, wo gbe ẹgua-a.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ebram vwo ikpe ovo nuro vwe ujori re orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke ebram o da ta ke mevwe oghene ro vwo egba yan nene uvwe wo gbe egua a

verses.text_urhobo: Ke Me vẹ owẹ re ọphọ, ku wo vwiẹ buebu gangan.
verses.text_romanized: ke me ve owe re opho ku wo vwie buebu gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram de she bọvwọ opharo rhuotọ, Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ebram de she bovwo opharo rhuoto oghene da ta ke

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, ọphọ mẹ vẹ owẹ herọ, ku wọ cha dia ọsẹ rẹ ẹgborho buebu.
verses.text_romanized: nighe opho me ve owe hero ku wo cha dia ose re egborho buebu

verses.text_urhobo: E gbi se we Ebram ọfa-a, ẹkẹvuọvo ke se we Ebraham, fikiridie mi ru we vwọ dia ọsẹ rẹ ẹgborho buebu.
verses.text_romanized: e gbi se we ebram ofa a ekevuovo ke se we ebraham fikiridie mi ru we vwo dia ose re egborho buebu

verses.text_urhobo: Mi ru we vwọ dia ọgbọmiọvwọ, ẹgborho ride ki nẹ agada wẹn rhe, ivie ki nẹ oma wẹn rhe.
verses.text_romanized: mi ru we vwo dia ogbomiovwo egborho ride ki ne agada wen rhe ivie ki ne oma wen rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọphọ na kọ dia uvwre mẹ vẹ owẹ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn rọ cha vwẹ obuko wẹn; kọ dia ọphọ re rara, kọ dia Ọghẹnẹ kẹ wẹn kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn rọ cha obuko wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: opho na ko dia uvwre me ve owe kugbe uvwie wen ro cha vwe obuko wen ko dia opho re rara ko dia oghene ke wen kugbe uvwie wen ro cha obuko we

verses.text_urhobo: Ke Me vwọ kẹ wẹ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn rọ cha obuko wẹ, otọ nana rẹ ovwan da ọrharha na, otọ ri Kenan ejobi, kọ dia ẹkẹn uku wẹn bẹdẹ, ke Me dia Ọghẹnẹ rayen.
verses.text_romanized: ke me vwo ke we kugbe uvwie wen ro cha obuko we oto nana re ovwan da orharha na oto ri kenan ejobi ko dia eken uku wen bede ke me dia oghene rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ Ebraham, Vwọ kẹ wẹ, ku wọ sẹro rẹ ọphọ mẹ na, te owẹ vẹ emọ wẹn kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn ejobi re cha vwẹ obuko wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ke ebraham vwo ke we ku wo sero re opho me na te owe ve emo wen kugbe uvwie wen ejobi re cha vwe obuko wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọnana kọye ọphọ mẹ na, ru wọ sẹro rọye na, rọ uvwre mẹ vẹ owẹ kugbe emọ wẹn re cha obuko wẹn na: Kọshare kọshare rọ uvwre rẹ ovwan kọ yanvwe.
verses.text_romanized: onana koye opho me na ru wo sero roye na ro uvwre me ve owe kugbe emo wen re cha obuko wen na koshare koshare ro uvwre re ovwan ko yanvwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ku wọ yanvwe ohọrọ rẹ ẹsosuọ rẹ oma wẹn, kọ cha dia oka rẹ ọphọ rọ uvwre mẹ vẹ owẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ku wo yanvwe ohoro re esosuo re oma wen ko cha dia oka re opho ro uvwre me ve owe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ ro te ẹdẹ ẹrenren nure vwẹ usun rẹ ovwan ka yanvwọ; kọshare kọshare vwẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ejobi, ọ re vwiẹri vwẹ uwevwi wẹn eyẹ ọ ra vwẹ igho dẹ eyẹ ọrharha rọ dia uwviẹ wẹ-ẹn.
verses.text_romanized: o ro te ede erenren nure vwe usun re ovwan ka yanvwo koshare koshare vwe uvwie wen ejobi o re vwieri vwe uwevwi wen eye o ra vwe igho de eye orharha ro dia uwvie we en

verses.text_urhobo: Te ọ re vwiẹri vwẹ uwevwi wẹn kugbe ọ ra vwẹ igho dẹ, ka yanvwọ. Kọye ọphọ mẹ na kọ dia oma wẹn dia ọphọ re rara.
verses.text_romanized: te o re vwieri vwe uwevwi wen kugbe o ra vwe igho de ka yanvwo koye opho me na ko dia oma wen dia opho re rara

verses.text_urhobo: Kọshare kọshare ra yanvwe jovwo-o rọ gbe rha yanvwe ohọrọ rẹ ẹsosuọ rẹ oma rọye-e, ke bro kufia nẹ usun rẹ ihwo rọye, yọ chọ urhi rẹ ọphọ mẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: koshare koshare ra yanvwe jovwo o ro gbe rha yanvwe ohoro re esosuo re oma roye e ke bro kufia ne usun re ihwo roye yo cho urhi re opho me na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ Ebraham, Vwọ kẹ Serai rẹ aye wẹn, wo gbi se Serai ọfa-a, ẹkẹvuọvo Sera kọye dia odẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ke ebraham vwo ke serai re aye wen wo gbi se serai ofa a ekevuovo sera koye dia ode roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ke Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ, ọ rọ marho ke Me kẹ ọmọ vwiẹ kẹ wẹ; ki mi bruphihọ kẹ, ko dia oni rẹ ẹgborho buebu; ivie rẹ ihwo ki nẹ agada rọye rhe.
verses.text_romanized: ke me ne erhovwo ke o ro marho ke me ke omo vwie ke we ki mi bruphiho ke ko dia oni re egborho buebu ivie re ihwo ki ne agada roye rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham de gbe opharo otọ ọ da hwẹ, ọ da ta kẹ oma rọye, Kẹ ohwo rọ ghwo te ikpe ujori nure na se vwiẹ ọmọ? Ki Sera rẹ ikpe ujọne gbe ihwe na ji se vwiẹ ọmọ rhe?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham de gbe opharo oto o da hwe o da ta ke oma roye ke ohwo ro ghwo te ikpe ujori nure na se vwie omo ki sera re ikpe ujone gbe ihwe na ji se vwie omo rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta kẹ Ọghẹnẹ, E mane ke wan rhọvwe nẹ Ishmael dia obaro wẹn vwonẹ;
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta ke oghene e mane ke wan rhovwe ne ishmael dia obaro wen vwone

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Ẹjo, ẹkẹvuọvo Sera rẹ aye wẹn na che vwiẹ ọmọshare kẹ wẹ, ku wo se odẹ rọye Aizik. Ọphọ mẹ na kọ sẹ nene kọ dia ọphọ re rara kẹ vẹ uvwiẹ rọye rọ cha vwẹ obuko rọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ejo ekevuovo sera re aye wen na che vwie omoshare ke we ku wo se ode roye aizik opho me na ko se nene ko dia opho re rara ke ve uvwie roye ro cha vwe obuko roye

verses.text_urhobo: Vwọ kẹ Ishmael, mi nyo we; nighe, mi bruphihọ kẹ, kọ dia ọmiọvwọ ko ji bu gangan; kọ dia isun ihwivẹ, kọ dia ẹgborho rode.
verses.text_romanized: vwo ke ishmael mi nyo we nighe mi bruphiho ke ko dia omiovwo ko ji bu gangan ko dia isun ihwive ko dia egborho rode

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Aizik ọye ọphọ mẹ cha sẹ nene, ri Sera che vwiẹ kẹ vwẹ eghẹre ọtiọnana ukpe ọfa.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo aizik oye opho me cha se nene ri sera che vwie ke vwe eghere otionana ukpe ofa

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vẹ ọye vwọ ta ota ejobi nu, Ọghẹnẹ da yanran kpenu jẹ Ebraham vwo.
verses.text_romanized: oke re oghene ve oye vwo ta ota ejobi nu oghene da yanran kpenu je ebraham vwo

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham da reyọ Ishmael rẹ ọmọ rọye na kugbe ibiẹdo rọye re vwiẹ vwẹ uwevwi rọye eyẹ eviẹn ra vwẹ igho dẹ, kọshare kọshare vwẹ evun rẹ uwevwi rẹ Ebraham na, ọ da yanvwe ayen ejobi vwẹ ẹdẹ yena ọvuọvo na, kirobo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ta kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da reyo ishmael re omo roye na kugbe ibiedo roye re vwie vwe uwevwi roye eye evien ra vwe igho de koshare koshare vwe evun re uwevwi re ebraham na o da yanvwe ayen ejobi vwe ede yena ovuovo na kirobo re oghene ta ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da dia ikpe ọvo nuro ujori ọ ghwo te vwẹ ọke rọ vwọ yanvwe.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da dia ikpe ovo nuro ujori o ghwo te vwe oke ro vwo yanvwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ishmael rẹ ọmọ rọye da dia ikpe ihwerha ọke rọ vwọ yanvwe.
verses.text_romanized: ishmael re omo roye da dia ikpe ihwerha oke ro vwo yanvwe

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ẹdẹ yena ọvuọvo na ọye Ebraham vẹ ọmọ rọye Ishmael yanvwere;
verses.text_romanized: vwe ede yena ovuovo na oye ebraham ve omo roye ishmael yanvwere

verses.text_urhobo: te ire vwiẹri vwẹ uwevwi rọye te e ra vwẹ igho dẹ mie erhorha, a da yanvwe ayen ejobi kugbe.
verses.text_romanized: te ire vwieri vwe uwevwi roye te e ra vwe igho de mie erhorha a da yanvwe ayen ejobi kugbe
